_about: Mochi storage system (List 11 #106). Storage is a VIEW over the roster, not a second database: the individual record (#80 model; #96 roster section) gains ONE field, location, whose three kinds (party | garden | storage) make double-placement impossible. Sort/search are derived views, never stored. RELEASE is permanent deletion of the individual record, honestly modelled: a tombstone fact remains, the dex kept state does NOT revert (#14 states advance on events; release is not an un-keep event), and story-locked individuals are unreleasable under #68's lock, reused verbatim. Capacities are OPEN — no canon figures exist.

box_shape.label: the Ranger's own word for the box — display string via #23; owner content

location_field.joins: garden residence read by #58 follower system (PRINCIPAL roster-binding); eggs (#77) are location-legal in garden and storage

open_register: whether the partner/principal individual may be stored at all

release.dex_rule: #14 kept state persists after release, including releasing every individual of a species
release.effect: individual record deleted: variance roll (#80), honours (#104), and that individual's careLog entries (#28) go with it. No undo slot exists in this format.
release.lock_rule: story_locked individuals (#68) cannot be released — evaluated before any confirmation prompt; no second lock vocabulary is introduced
release.tombstone_home: append-only save history beside #12's history — NOT the roster; a tombstone can never resurrect a record

tombstone_shape.honoursCount: count only — the honours themselves are gone
